title: src/bindings.ts and src/shell/contract.ts are the only doors
context: Frontend needs systematic boundaries to prevent scattered coupling to backend.
decision: Two files exist purely as chokepoints: src/bindings.ts (only door to Rust via Tauri) and src/shell/contract.ts (interface vocabulary boundary). Their value is entirely in being the *only* way through.
consequences: Cannot add bypasses, even small or obviously-fine ones—the bypass cost exceeds the savings. Every Tauri command has exactly one typed wrapper in bindings.ts. Every type there mirrors a #[derive(Serialize)] struct on Rust side with 'Mirrors' comment.
